candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that credits msg.value to the caller's balance so deposits are no longer recorded.
Set unlockTime directly to _unlockTime instead of clamping it to at least the current timestamp.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer logged.
Delete `locked_ = true;` so the reentrancy lock is never engaged during Put.
Delete `locked_ = false;` so the lock is never released, causing all subsequent Put calls to revert.
